caseName: Sampayo v. Bank of Nova Scotia
caseNameFull: Carlota Benitez Sampayo v. Bank of Nova Scotia
attorneys: Carlota Benitez Sampayo, pro se. Mr. Henri Brown for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the First Circuit, and motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, denied. The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.
